title: Autumn–winter season at the Teatre Principal in Maó
description: Twenty-four productions between 2 October and 29 December, in the year the theatre marks twenty-five since its restoration: music, drama, opera, circus, comedy, puppetry and family matinees. The Orquestra de Cambra de la Illa de Menorca opens on 2 October; along the way, fado from Lina and Marco Mezquida (30 October), the zarzuela «La tabernera del puerto» (13 December) and a symphonic close on the 29th. Full programme and tickets on the theatre's own site.
imageAlt: Inside the Teatre Principal in Maó: a horseshoe of red and gold boxes, red seats and the painted curtain with a pastoral scene.
